coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of the eight ground-truth variable items match: query direction (child-to-parent versus parent-to-child) and retrieval accuracy (exact-match accuracy and completion log-likelihood). This yields 25%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output replaces the IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata cohorts and substitutes different models for GPT-3.5-turbo and Llama-7b/30b/65b. It does not establish the fixed evaluation scripts or explicitly compare chat-based versus completion-based interaction modes. Temperature is fixed at 0 rather than varied by model or condition. Statistical significance is assessed using McNemar tests and mixed-effects regression instead of the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion is supplied stating that child-to-parent retrieval should substantially outperform parent-to-child retrieval, confirming the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
